title: A ShopCoach line reads Title - Description in the Customer Invoice report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, added from the ShopCoach line builder, with no tech story.
  • Write down line 1's title and description exactly as work order 1's Lines tab shows them.
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads line 1's title, a space, a hyphen, a space, then line 1's description, exactly as written down, and nothing after the description.
  • The cell has no "What are you doing?", no "Why are you doing it?", no "Tech Story:" and no semicolon added by the app.

If the ShopCoach line builder shows nothing after Build Lines, line 1 cannot be made: that is the known problem https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11850 (staging, 27 Oct 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10131 (Story 2, The ShopCoach Line Builder), story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S2-R3: “What ShopCoach generates and writes into a line is unchanged. A generated line becomes an ordinary work order line and follows Story 3 like any other.”
  • S3-R1: “A line's text joins the title, the description and the technician's narrative with a spaced hyphen and no labels: "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".”
  • S3-R3: “A separator appears only between two segments that are both present. A line with no description joins the title straight to the narrative. A line with no narrative ends after the description. A line with neither carries the title alone. In every case there is no trailing separator and no trailing space. A segment made only of spaces counts as absent.”
  • S3-R6: “A line with no narrative ends after the description, with no trailing hyphen and no trailing space. A narrative is absent when the value is empty, is made only of spaces, or is the literal placeholder "Tech story missing."; the three are treated identically, and none reaches QuickBooks. The Edit Line window writes the placeholder when an existing line with no tech story is saved from it; a line saved from New Line keeps an empty tech story. Neither depends on completion or on Require Tech Story.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
